purpose: Select a rectification methodology with fair geometry, image-preservation, abstention and resource evidence. The M3 retrospective synthetic bank remains a development set.

tiers.name: estimator-only
tiers.input: Identical independently measured intersections, line observations and IDs, with controlled noise and explicit identity faults.
tiers.question: Which estimator is most accurate and stable conditional on the observations?
tiers.limit: Does not compare detectors, RGB handling or full products.

tiers.name: frozen-native-geometry
tiers.input: Same original RGB with each native detector and its predeclared settings. Native output geometry is evaluated without truth-based scale/orientation repair.
tiers.question: What fraction of the fixed visible physical domain is returned correctly, wrongly or not returned?
tiers.limit: Products without accessible geometry require a separate raster-landmark contract.

tiers.name: end-to-end-image-and-signal
tiers.input: The same original RGB and complete native output, including failures, crops, fallbacks and original preservation.
tiers.question: Are traces, text, calibration and layout preserved, and does downstream signal extraction retain amplitude/time/lead identity?
tiers.limit: Signal SNR cannot substitute for geometry error or prove clinical equivalence.

data_partitions.holdout: Lock genuine held-out manufacturers, sessions and physical capture conditions before model or threshold choice. Near duplicates, reprints, crops and alternate photos of one recording stay in the same split.
data_partitions.known_dataset_overlap: ECG-image-database Ahus/Emory/PTB-XL is not automatically external to npj or challenge-trained solutions. Audit by source identifiers and perceptual near-duplicates, and mark unknown competitor training overlap.
data_partitions.sample_size: Determine paired precision/power from a separate pilot and predeclare the unit as patient or independent document. Do not infer population performance from the single compatible M3 example.

truth.geometry: Independently surveyed physical or nominal chart landmarks, with an explicit target definition and measurement uncertainty. Hide scoring correspondences from inference. Report what portions lack trustworthy truth.
truth.image: Flat scan or measured reference of the same printed page plus original capture, with trace/text/calibration annotations independent of each method. Occluded ink is not treated as recoverable truth in visible-coverage scores.
truth.signal: Original waveform with units, lead ownership, sequential time windows, gain and speed retained separately from image geometry.
truth.annotation: Independent annotation and disagreement estimate, with blinded adjudication for critical landmarks. Renderer-exported coordinates are not physical-camera metrology.

primary_geometry_metrics: G, W, C and W/C on a fixed input-visible query domain at a preregistered engineering threshold
separately predeclared uniform canonical material-area queries and uniform source-visible pixel queries, with no confidence-derived evaluation domain
native orientation and scale with only a declared gauge adjustment that does not erase the evaluated ambiguity
conditional RMSE, p95, p99, maximum and common-support paired errors
wrong confident outputs, rejection, fallback and uncertainty calibration
seams, local scale bias, inverse ambiguity, fold and horizon incidence
separate_image_metrics: actual full inverse footprint and returned image coverage
object-wise thin trace, spike and decimal-point disappearance, width, contrast, energy and phase sensitivity, not just whole-image means
text and calibration-mark preservation, border crops and lead-window ownership
image file decode, dimensions, alpha and publication integrity

execution.arms: Use exact released code/checkpoint/settings and author licences. Each rank is not necessarily a distinct rectifier. Group borrowed Heng stages and separate geometry variants.
execution.failure: All scheduled cases remain in denominator, including exceptions, degenerate outputs, missing geometry, original fallbacks and timeouts. C=0 gives undefined W/C, not zero risk.
execution.fairness: Report in-scope and out-of-scope strata separately, train-source familiarity, information supplied to each method, resolution and output field of view. Do not choose competitor presets per image using truth.
execution.resources: Named hardware, thread limits, cold and warm latency, memory, preprocessing, resampling and file I/O. CPU-only evidence cannot establish GPU performance.
execution.statistics: Paired analysis by independent group, preregistered primary comparisons, uncertainty intervals and multiplicity handling. Resamples and grid queries are not independent patients.
execution.commercial: Powerful Medical remains not executed without authorized access. If authorized later, evaluate native product output with a declared raster-landmark contract when its internal field is not exposed. Do not equate an analytic reconstruction of a patent with the commercial product.

promotion: Promote a component only after its adverse strata and resource limits pass. Promote a complete method only after a frozen external test, not because one component wins a synthetic mean.
